description.value: The Gold Bridge Hotel is a historic hotel and pub in the remote gold-rush town of Gold Bridge, nestled in BC's Bridge River Valley — one of the few services in a region defined by rugged backcountry and mining heritage. The current building was originally the Legion hall from the nearby ghost town of Bralorne, relocated and reimagined; the current owner has renovated it since 2018 while preserving its small-town character. Guests can unwind in the hot tub or sauna after a long ride, and the on-site pub and restaurant make it a natural gathering point in an area with very limited alternatives.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website fetched successfully across multiple subpages, confirming the hotel is open with an active 2025 copyright and a functioning booking system. The contact page provides a physical address (6 Fergusson Ave, Gold Bridge, BC) and phone (250-238-2343) not present in the OSM tags; the about-us and rooms pages describe facilities in detail but contain no mention of cyclist-specific amenities such as bike storage, laundry, or Wi-Fi. The OSM name 'Gold Bridge Hotel' (two words) differs from the website's consistent usage of 'Goldbridge Hotel' (one word), which is flagged as a concern.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM records 'Gold Bridge Hotel' (two words) but the website consistently uses 'Goldbridge Hotel' (one word) — the current trading name may differ from the OSM entry.
